<color=#ffffff>Dishes</color>

customize.name: Lasagna
customize.desc: A baked pasta dish. Spread cheese, meat sauce, and Béchamel sauce on a layer of pasta strips, and place another layer of pasta strips on the top - repeat the process a few times and bake the pasta until the cheese becomes golden and bubbly. The secret of its tastiness lies in the carefully-prepared meat sauce.

customize.name: Delicious Lasagna
customize.desc: A baked pasta dish. The song of Pots and Fire eulogizes the meat sauce's ascension to he Pasta Throne. The moment it enters your mouth, it graces you with bliss so unparalleled that you almost want to make today Lasagna Day!

customize.name: Suspicious Lasagna
customize.desc: A baked pasta dish. The pasta and fillings are haphazardly mixed together, and the texture leaves a lot to be desired. You can almost feel the Lasagna becoming lodged in your throat — but don't worry, this isn't the worst part. You still have the next bite, which will be even harder to swallow.

customize.name: Sanguinetti
customize.desc: The host of Hotel Debord. Underneath his calm and elegant exterior, he scoffs at customers who buy the most expensive dishes in an attempt to flaunt their wealth instead of focusing on and appreciating the taste of such fine delicacies.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.
